name.baseName: xx Grass silage organic, at farm

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of grass silage from intensive organic production with 1.65 kg CO2 and an average of 18.3 MJ per kg dry matter (17.9 MJ/kg DM for intensive and 18.9 MJ/kg DM for extensive) . The dry matter content of grass silage is about 35%; UUID: 9f8d8419-458d-3c82-972a-0d014eccbec3

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Intensive and extnesive ogranic production.

# Included processes
The inventories include the organic production of grass for silage from 40% natural intensive meadows, 40% natural extensive meadows and 20% temporary meadows. Included steps are soil cultivation, fertilisation (slurry and manure), harvest, baling, loading and transport.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: Passed.; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
